max-nesting-depth.message: Keep SCSS nesting shallow (max 2). Deep nesting couples styles to DOM shape. (docs/standards/styling-and-sass.md)

declaration-no-important.message: !important requires a documented reason. Add a stylelint-disable comment explaining why. (docs/standards/styling-and-sass.md)

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Use logical values (start/end, inline-start/inline-end) so Arabic RTL and English LTR both work. (ADR-013)

property-disallowed-list.message: Use CSS logical properties (margin-inline-*, padding-inline-*, border-inline-*, inset-inline-*) so RTL and LTR both work without overrides. (ADR-013)

selector-class-pattern.message: Class names are camelCase for SCSS Modules (styles.itemLabel) or u-prefixed kebab-case for the small global utility set (.u-stack-tight).
